prompt: Vertical 9:16 snapshot from a 1990s point-and-shoot with harsh on-camera flash, orange date stamp "97 11 13" in the corner, red-eye, flat shadows behind heads. In a wood-panelled boardroom, three anonymous middle-aged men in loosened ties sprawl on the table among uncut sheets of fresh banknotes from an unmarked currency, ink still glossy. One holds a sheet to his face and inhales deeply, eyes rolled up; another wears a sheet as a scarf, grinning. Behind them a hulking printing press glows through an open door. Cigarette smoke, spilled whisky, slightly tilted frame. Thanks.
